shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a long rectangular island stands between the refrigerator wall and the sink area, with stools arranged along its sides. A woman in a cobalt sweater sits at the sink-side guest stool and asks a question, while a man in a mustard hoodie sits at the refrigerator-side guest stool and a woman in an emerald cardigan sits at the sink-end stool.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the refrigerator end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the sink area, with both guest-side stools and the sink-end stool in frame.

shots.content: The woman in the cobalt sweater at the sink-side guest stool swaps seats with the man in the mustard hoodie at the refrigerator-side guest stool, who answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the cook side, centered on the two adjacent guest-side stools.

shots.content: The woman in the emerald cardigan replies.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the sink end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the refrigerator wall, with both guest-side stools and the sink-end stool in frame.
